'''2000 DragonCon Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship on Decipher's 2000 summer convention circuit. The winner received a bye to the semifinal round of the World Championship and travel to DecipherCon 2000.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sc00dc">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/dragoncon.html Decipher's @ DragonCon 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231238/http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/dragoncon.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Clint Hays]] of Mount Juliet, Tennessee won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 29 June – 2 July 2000
* '''Site:''' DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia; Hyatt, Atlanta, Georgia<ref name="tr-d962" />
* '''Players:''' about 65<ref name="tr-d966" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 DragonCon Open Andy McClure Undefeated- ISB ORS S+V None Shall Pass]] ([[Andy McClure]], [[Dark]]; 3rd) — "I placed 3rd in the Open"; it "went 3-0 at the DragonCon Open"
* [[2000 DragonCon Open Andy McClure Echo Base Beatdown- DragonCon tested]] ([[Andy McClure]], [[Light]]; 3rd) — "it went 2-1, it's only loss to Steven Lewis"

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The List of SWCCG tournaments gives 29 June 2000 for the Open, but Gordon's, Cowart's and Hays's reports put it on Friday 30 June 2000 (29 June was the Thursday side tournament).<ref name="tr-d966" />
* The List of SWCCG tournaments gives 29 June 2000, but Cowart says he arrived Thursday 29 June and the Open started at 1 pm the next day (Friday 30 June).<ref name="tr-d962" />
